display.purpose: The landing page's single giant headline; lowercase, bold (700).

label.purpose: Lowercase 13px semibold labels for nav, buttons, chips and section headings.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Menus, listboxes, toasts, a dragged row, tile hover. Never on resting surfaces.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Entrance and hover transitions; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Recipe Tile
components.description: The square unit of the shelf — an ingredient tint or a full-bleed photo with a cream title strip.
components.css: .ds-tile { position: relative; display: block; width: 148px; height: 148px; background: rgb(255 75 38 / 0.25); color: #16130e; border: 1px solid rgb(22 19 14 / 0.18); text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-tile:hover { box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -4px rgb(22 19 14 / 0.14), 0 1px 3px rgb(22 19 14 / 0.06); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b3df5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile-title { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 10px; left: 12px; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Active Chip
components.description: A selected filter chip: yolk tint with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: rgb(255 194 28 / 0.4); color: #16130e; border: 1px solid rgb(22 19 14 / 0.18); padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Add Tile
components.css: .ds-add-tile { width: 148px; height: 148px; background: transparent; color: #16130e; border: 1px dashed rgb(22 19 14 / 0.4); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-add-tile:hover { background: #fffdf8; } .ds-add-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b3df5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Basil save/confirm action: solid fill, no border, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2fa84f; color: #16130e; border: 0; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b3df5; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Square paper field with a 1px field-line border; focus shows the eggplant outline.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fdf6ec; color: #16130e; border: 1px solid rgb(22 19 14 / 0.4); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input::placeholder { opacity: 0.5; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b3df5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Left-rail row; the active row is a yolk 30% tint with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; color: #16130e; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #fffdf8; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-color: rgb(22 19 14 / 0.15); background: rgb(255 194 28 / 0.3); }

narrative.overview: dutch-oven looks like a well-used kitchen wall: butcher-paper ground, ink drawn as hairlines, and the colors of ingredients used as gentle tints. Flat, square and quiet; the left sidebar is the reference for everything. Rejected worlds: neobrutalist, metro tiles on pure black, pantry-shelf, diner ticket-rail.
keyCharacteristics: Butcher-paper cream ground, never white, never dark
One 1px hairline weight: ink at 18% for surfaces, 40% for fields
Square corners, zero gradients, no shadow on resting surfaces
Ingredient colors are tints; one solid primary action per screen
Lowercase semibold labels; weight and size carry hierarchy

rules.name: The Ingredient Rule
rules.body: Color comes from the kitchen, not a brand book. A tint is tomato, yolk, basil, or eggplant — never 'blue' or 'indigo'.

rules.name: The One-Solid Rule
rules.body: At most one saturated solid fill per screen, on the primary action. Everything else is a tint or paper.

rules.name: The Lowercase Rule
rules.body: All UI copy is lowercase, labels included. No Title Case, no uppercase, no tracking.

rules.name: The Declare-Once Rule
rules.body: A surface is elevated by a hairline or by a shadow, never both. No hard offset shadows anywhere.

dos: Do keep every border one hairline weight; use the 40% field line only for inputs and secondary buttons.
Do tint ingredient colors and keep one solid fill for the primary action.
Do use dashed borders for anything the user hasn't created yet.
Do let weight and size make hierarchy.
donts: Don't use hard offset shadows, 2px ink borders, uppercase labels or rotated stickers.
Don't put a border and a shadow on the same surface.
Don't use gray-on-color secondary text; tint from the surface's ink.
Don't resurrect rejected worlds: neobrutalist, metro-black, pantry-shelf, diner ticket-rail.
